name: ibis budget Jakarta Airport
short_description: A 185-room budget hotel with Cocoon-style rooms in Rawa Bokor, Tangerang, about 10 minutes by car from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport with a complimentary shuttle.
ai_summary: ibis budget Jakarta Airport is a 2-star economy hotel at Jl Raya Bandara Soekarno Hatta, Kp Rawa Bokor, Tangerang, about 10 minutes by car from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) and roughly 25 km from central Jakarta. It shares the same Rawa Bokor cluster and airport shuttle contact details as the separate, higher-tier ibis Styles Jakarta Airport property nearby, but is its own distinct 185-room hotel with a different Accor hotel ID. Rooms use the compact 14 sqm Cocoon design across three configurations, and the hotel offers a complimentary shuttle running roughly every 120 minutes, three meeting rooms, and breakfast. Accor's own listing shows a strong 4.8/5 ALL rating from 285 reviews, and independent 2024-2025 TripAdvisor and Trip.com reviews are largely positive, with guests calling it a good, clean, convenient transit hotel and praising friendly staff, though a few reviews note small rooms and inconsistent air conditioning. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Jakarta Airport from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about 10 minutes by car from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and offers a complimentary shuttle running roughly every 120 minutes, making it a practical choice for early departures or late arrivals, though travelers with tight connections should plan around the shuttle's fixed interval.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Jakarta Airport the same hotel as ibis Styles Jakarta Airport?
faqs.answer: No -- they are two distinct Accor properties in the same Rawa Bokor area near Soekarno-Hatta Airport, each with its own separate hotel ID on the Accor booking platform. ibis budget Jakarta Airport is the smaller, more compact economy-tier option with 185 Cocoon-style rooms, while ibis Styles Jakarta Airport is a separate, larger sister property.

faqs.question: Does ibis budget Jakarta Airport participate in the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points here, though it still carries a strong 4.8/5 guest rating from 285 reviews and ALL member rates may still apply.
